criteria.reason: Says communes can restrict use and cantons handle noise, but does not clearly state cantons can already restrict fireworks.
Notes dependence on local/cantonal rules, but mislabels Lärmschutzgesetz as SVG, reducing reliability.
Provides actionable local steps: contact Gemeindeverwaltung/Polizei, petition, check Kanton Luzern.
Does not mention the national initiative, so it avoids advocacy but misses the neutral side note.

factual_errors: Lärmschutzgesetz SVG is incorrect; SVG is the Strassenverkehrsgesetz, not the Lärmschutzgesetz.
summary: Partly helpful and in German, but incomplete on cantonal competence and contains a wrong legal reference.
